correctness.rationale: TARGET route: proved the positive (empty-wall) side of the admitted target. Replayed verify_target.py successfully (chi(E,I_L)=2, chi(O,I_L)=0, projected class (-3,2,-3), Delta=220, chi(u,u)=-2, Im(M)=5, zero BG-compatible both-Im-positive candidates in |ni|<=30, VERIFY_OK). Independently checked HRR with td=(H/2,17L/6,P): chi(I_L)=0 and chi(E,I_L)=-7/3-1/2+17/6+2=2, cross-checked via chi(E^vee)=5 minus restriction 3. Projection [I_L]-2[E] follows since chi(O,I_L)=0 kills the O-correction and chi(E,O)-independence holds at K0 level; truncated subtraction (1,0,-1)-2(2,-1,1)=(-3,2,-3) is correct. Primitivity gcd(3,2)=1, (-2)-class via g=6 Gram [[-2,-3],[-3,-5]], and Im_{-1/2}=10n1+5n0 in 5Z with total 5 are correct. Hence 5 cannot split into two positive multiples of 5, so no decomposition in Coh^{-1/2}(X) has both factors Im-positive; a zero-Im factor has slope +infinity versus finite slope of M, so no numerical tilt wall exists for any alpha>0 and no strictly semistable object or sharp destabilizer occurs. Compared with topic.audit_preflight: type/normalization, nonvacuity, and table-lookup preflights all remain true; no ADMISSION_DEFECT. The Bridgeland double-tilt transfer is honestly labeled conditional and is not part of the audited headline.

originality.rationale: TARGET route: headline is the empty beta=-1/2 tilt wall for the primitive line-ideal projection class (-3,2,-3) on a Brill-Noether-general ordinary GM threefold. Fused live search (SerpBase/Serpent + Crossref + OpenAlex, all ok, OpenAlex zero hits) over literal, equivalent/quiver/Chern, and broader/database directions returns only Brill-Noether reconstruction (2207.01021), categorical Torelli (2108.02946), GM classification (1510.05448), and PPZ stability/moduli work. Full inspection of JLZ 2207.01021v2 shows it treats projections of skyscraper sheaves i^*O_x (point class) and general wall-finding methods (Sec 4.3), never the line-ideal class pr(I_L), never the integers (-3,2,-3), never beta=-1/2 with Im=5 quantization. GM classification records Fano schemes of lines and Lagrangian data, not tilt walls. PPZ constructs Serre-invariant conditions and moduli projectivity but no line-wall equation or destabilizer. No synonymous, dual/complement, matrix/quiver, broader-census, table, or recomputation source substantively implies the claim; see decisive_checks. Hence the wall-exclusion lemma is new.

value.rationale: TARGET route with Admission value approval intact: the empty-wall verdict resolves the admitted two-sided target on its positive side and is independently worth retrieving. Object (line-ideal projection on ordinary GM threefold) and invariant (beta=-1/2 tilt-wall emptiness with logged Chern data) were motivated before computation by Brill-Noether reconstruction, categorical Torelli, and Abel-Jacobi fiber arguments that assume unproven line-projection stability inputs. The value is not known or mechanically implied: general wall methods and Fano-line geometry do not imply the Im=5 minimality for (-3,2,-3). It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration but a rigorous arithmetic exclusion plus HRR-logged class, conic separation ((-1,1,-2), Delta 60), and replayable certificate that future wall-crossing/moduli work can cite as a wall-exclusion lemma. Compared with topic.audit_preflight positive/negative resolution cases, both sides were pre-qualified as valuable and the positive side delivers the stable line-class point; no ADMISSION_DEFECT, and no paper-level general theorem is demanded for this exact invariant.

The overlapping hits duplicated the already-audited Brill-Noether reconstruction, Torelli, and PPZ stability sources. The 10 new hits were screened literally: the closest leads were (i) the beta=-9/10 no-wall lemma for 3v-2w, which is sign-related but on a different vertical beta-line and a different wall-crossing step than the submitted beta=-1/2 Im=5 exclusion for (-3,2,-3); (ii) the survey snippet identifying a Kuznetsov Bridgeland moduli space with the Fano surface of lines, which is an induced-stability isomorphism rather than a tilt-wall equation; and (iii) Zhang 2012.12193, verified in full text to treat twisted-cubic/conic classes only. No returned source writes the submitted Chern integers, the beta=-1/2 slope-equality computation, or any stronger theorem, census, or table entry substantively implying the empty-W2 verdict. Originality PASS is therefore preserved with no decisive prior and no incremental decisive recall.
